var u = typeof input === 'string' ? input : (input && input.url) || '';
// Apply the saved colour theme before first paint (no flash). site-settings.js owns the setting.
* Each theme is a set of colour variables on <html data-theme="name">. The choice is saved by
* site-settings.js and applied by the inline script in index.html <head> before first paint.
* The site has two themes: "ying-yang" (Black, the site default) and "light" (White).
* "ying-yang" is the default and is also applied when no (or an unknown) theme is set.
* --accent-text is the readable text colour for anything drawn on top of --accent. */
/* Light theme: deepen the fixed gold / red / green text colours (made for dark backgrounds) so they
stay readable on white, and outline the white half of the yin-yang logo. */
* Animated multi-colour text used for headings across the site: ….
* A slow-moving gradient is clipped to the glyphs while the word gently tilts and breathes. */
background-image: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--bright-text), var(--text-2), var(--bright-text), var(--text-2), var(--bright-text));
border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 6%, transparent);
background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 8%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 8%, transparent);
.cc-btn-primary { background: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-text); font-weight: 600; }
background: none; border: none; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 60%, transparent); font-size: 1.15rem;
width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 8px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
flex-shrink: 0; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; font-family: inherit;
.cc-icon-btn:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 8%, transparent); color: var(--bright-text); }
.cc-link-btn { background: none; border: none; color: var(--accent); font-size: 0.75rem; font-family: inherit; padding: 4px; }
color: #fa777c; background: rgba(237, 66, 69, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(237, 66, 69, 0.3);
.cc-hint { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 35%, transparent); font-size: 0.7rem; }
.cc-login { flex: 1; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 20px; }
width: 100%; max-width: 400px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;
background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-3) 75%, transparent); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 6%, transparent);

.cc-login-card label { display: block; text-align: left; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 55%, transparent); font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.5px; margin-bottom: 6px; }
width: 100%; background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 6%, transparent); border-radius: 8px;
color: var(--bright-text); padding: 11px 12px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; outline: none;
.cc-login-sub { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 50%, transparent); font-size: 0.85rem; margin-bottom: 8px; }

.cc-login-icon { width: 64px; height: 64px; margin: 0 auto 4px; color: var(--accent-text); background: var(--accent); border-radius: 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; }
/* Secret owner login: a faint crown in the card's top-right corner */
position: absolute; top: 10px; right: 10px; width: 30px; height: 30px; border: none; border-radius: 8px;
background: none; font-size: 1rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; opacity: 0.22; filter: grayscale(0.6);
.cc-owner-login-btn.on { opacity: 1; filter: none; background: rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.12); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255, 215, 0, 0.35); }
.cc-chat { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; position: relative; }
display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 10px 14px;
border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 6%, transparent); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 15%, transparent);
.cc-channel { flex: 1; color: var(--bright-text); font-weight: 600; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 0; }
.cc-hash { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 35%, transparent); font-size: 1.3rem; font-weight: 400; }
.cc-online { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 40%, transparent); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 400; margin-left: 8px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; }
.cc-online i { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: #23a55a; display: inline-block; }
.cc-me { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 8px 4px 4px; border-radius: 10px; min-width: 0; }
.cc-xpbar { width: 110px; height: 5px; border-radius: 4px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 10%, transparent); overflow: hidden; margin-top: 3px; }
.cc-xpbar > div { height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2)); border-radius: 4px; transition: width 0.4s; }
.cc-xptext { font-size: 0.6rem; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 40%, transparent); }
.cc-messages { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 8px 0 12px; overscroll-behavior: contain; }
.cc-messages::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 12%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; }
.cc-history-status { text-align: center; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 35%, transparent); font-size: 0.75rem; padding: 10px 16px; }
.cc-history-status h3 { color: var(--bright-text); font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 4px; }
.cc-day { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; margin: 14px 16px 6px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 35%, transparent); font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; }
.cc-day::before, .cc-day::after { content: ""; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 7%, transparent); }
/* Messages: others on the left, your own on the right */
.cc-msg { display: flex; gap: 12px; padding: 2px 16px; margin-top: 12px; align-items: flex-start; }
.cc-msg-body { min-width: 0; max-width: min(75%, 640px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; }
.cc-msg-head { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 6px; margin-bottom: 3px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.cc-time { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 30%, transparent); font-size: 0.65rem; }
color: var(--text); font-size: 0.9rem; line-height: 1.45; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 4px 14px 14px 14px;
background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 5%, transparent); word-wrap: break-word; overflow-wrap: anywhere; white-space: pre-wrap;
.cc-bubble code { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 35%, transparent); border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 4px; font-family: Consolas, monospace; font-size: 0.82rem; }
.cc-at { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent); color: var(--bright-text); border-radius: 3px; padding: 0 2px; font-weight: 600; }
.cc-msg-img { max-width: min(320px, 100%); max-height: 300px; border-radius: 10px; margin-top: 4px; display: block; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 6%, transparent); }
.cc-name { font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.88rem; color: var(--bright-text); white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; max-width: 100%; }
.cc-lvl { font-size: 0.6rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-text); background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2)); padding: 1px 6px; border-radius: 6px; }
.cc-status { font-size: 0.7rem; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 40%, transparent); }
.cc-font-cursive { font-family: "Brush Script MT", "Segoe Script", cursive; font-size: 1.05em; }
.cc-avatar { position: relative; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 50%; flex-shrink: 0; }

.cc-avatar-img { width: 100%; height: 100%; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.95rem; overflow: hidden; }
.cc-avatar::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -3px; border-radius: 50%; pointer-events: none; }

.cc-deco-rainbow::after { inset: -4px; padding: 3px; background: conic-gradient(#ff004c, #ffb300, #3cff00, #00d0ff, #a100ff, #ff004c); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask-composite: exclude; animation: cc-spin 3s linear infinite; }
.cc-deco-fire::after { inset: -4px; border: 3px solid #ff6a00; box-shadow: 0 0 12px #ff3d00, 0 -4px 14px #ffb300; animation: cc-flicker 0.9s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }

.cc-deco-gold::after { inset: -4px; padding: 3px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff1a8, #d4a017, #fff1a8, #b8860b); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask-composite: exclude; }
.cc-deco-neon::after { border: 2px solid #ff2bd6; box-shadow: 0 0 8px #ff2bd6, 0 0 16px #00f0ff; animation: cc-pulse 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
.cc-deco-sakura::after { content: "🌸"; inset: auto -6px -6px auto; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)); }
/* Current built-in set (lib/chatroom.ts DECORATIONS). The rules above are kept for older saved values. */
.cc-deco-halo::after { border: 2px solid #ffe08a; box-shadow: 0 0 10px #ffd54f, inset 0 0 6px rgba(255, 224, 138, 0.6); animation: cc-halo 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; }

.cc-deco-catears::before { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 2%; right: 2%; top: -26%; height: 42%; background: linear-gradient(#f8b4d9, #e46ba6); clip-path: polygon(4% 100%, 16% 0, 40% 100%, 60% 100%, 84% 0, 96% 100%); pointer-events: none; }

.cc-deco-vines::before { content: "🌿"; position: absolute; left: -6px; bottom: -6px; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; transform: scaleX(-1); z-index: 1; pointer-events: none; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)); }
.cc-deco-flame::after { inset: -4px; border: 3px solid #ff6a00; box-shadow: 0 0 12px #ff3d00, 0 -4px 14px #ffb300; animation: cc-flicker 0.9s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.cc-deco-glitch::after { border: 2px solid #fff; animation: cc-glitch 1.2s steps(2, end) infinite; }

.cc-deco-crown::after { inset: -4px; padding: 3px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #fff1a8, #d4a017, #fff1a8, #b8860b); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(#000 0 0) content-box, linear-gradient(#000 0 0); -webkit-mask-composite: xor; mask-composite: exclude; }

.cc-deco-crown::before { content: "👑"; position: absolute; left: 50%; top: -14px; transform: translateX(-50%) rotate(-8deg); font-size: 16px; line-height: 1; z-index: 1; pointer-events: none; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 3px rgba(255, 213, 79, 0.8)); }
/* Image decorations (Discord avatar decorations, flag frames): drawn 120% of the avatar, like Discord does. */
.cc-deco-img { position: absolute; top: -10%; left: -10%; width: 120%; height: 120%; max-width: none; pointer-events: none; user-select: none; z-index: 1; }
.cc-typing { height: 22px; padding: 0 16px; font-size: 0.72rem; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 55%, transparent); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.cc-dots span { width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 70%, transparent); animation: cc-bounce 1.2s infinite; }
@keyframes cc-bounce { 0%, 60%, 100% { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 0.5; } 30% { transform: translateY(-3px); opacity: 1; } }
position: absolute; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%); bottom: 96px; z-index: 3;
background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-text); border: none; border-radius: 20px; padding: 6px 14px; font-size: 0.75rem; font-family: inherit; font-weight: 600;
.cc-composer { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 4px; background: var(--bg-4); border-radius: 12px; padding: 4px 6px; }
flex: 1; resize: none; background: none; border: none; outline: none; color: var(--bright-text); font-family: inherit;
.cc-composer textarea::placeholder { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 35%, transparent); }

.cc-gif-btn { font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.02em; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 5px; padding: 1px 4px; margin: 0 2px; line-height: 1.2; height: auto; width: auto; align-self: center; }
.cc-upload-btn { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 12%, transparent); border-radius: 50%; width: 26px; height: 26px; margin: 5px; font-size: 1rem; color: var(--bright-text); }
.cc-composer-error { color: #fa777c; font-size: 0.78rem; padding: 8px 12px; margin-bottom: 8px; background: rgba(237, 66, 69, 0.1); border: 1px solid rgba(237, 66, 69, 0.3); border-radius: 8px; }

.cc-image-preview { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; background: var(--bg-3); border-radius: 10px; padding: 8px; margin-bottom: 8px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 60%, transparent); font-size: 0.75rem; }
.cc-image-preview img { width: 64px; height: 64px; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 8px; }
position: absolute; right: 14px; bottom: 62px; width: 330px; max-width: calc(100% - 28px); height: 340px; z-index: 5;
background: var(--bg-3); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 8%, transparent); border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden;
.cc-emoji-picker-inline { position: relative; right: auto; bottom: auto; width: 100%; max-width: none; height: 260px; margin-top: 8px; }
.cc-emoji-search { margin: 8px; background: var(--bg-2); border: none; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--bright-text); padding: 7px 10px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.8rem; outline: none; }
.cc-emoji-tabs { display: flex; gap: 2px; padding: 0 6px 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 6%, transparent); }
.cc-emoji-tabs button { background: none; border: none; font-size: 1.05rem; padding: 4px; border-radius: 6px; flex: 1; }
.cc-emoji-tabs button:hover, .cc-emoji-tabs button.active { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 8%, transparent); }
.cc-emoji-grid { flex: 1; overflow-y: auto; padding: 6px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(36px, 1fr)); align-content: start; }
.cc-emoji-grid h5 { grid-column: 1 / -1; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 45%, transparent); font-size: 0.65rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; margin: 6px 4px 4px; }
.cc-emoji-grid button { background: none; border: none; font-size: 1.45rem; padding: 3px; border-radius: 6px; line-height: 1.2; }
.cc-emoji-grid button:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 10%, transparent); }
.cc-modal { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 60; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 16px; }

.cc-modal-card { width: 100%; max-width: 920px; max-height: 92vh; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--bg-3); border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 6%, transparent); }
.cc-modal-head { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 14px 18px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 6%, transparent); }
.cc-settings-body { display: flex; gap: 20px; padding: 18px; overflow-y: auto; }
.cc-settings-form { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 18px; }
.cc-settings-form section { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }

.cc-settings-form h4 { color: var(--bright-text); font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding-bottom: 6px; border-bottom: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 6%, transparent); }

.cc-settings-form label { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 60%, transparent); font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.4px; margin-top: 6px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.cc-settings-form label.cc-check { text-transform: none; font-size: 0.8rem; margin: 0; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 75%, transparent); }
.cc-settings-form input[type="color"] { width: 42px; height: 34px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: none; padding: 0; }

.cc-nitro-tag { text-transform: none; letter-spacing: 0; font-size: 0.6rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--accent-text); background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2)); padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 8px; }
.cc-upload-row, .cc-key-row, .cc-status-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.cc-deco-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(72px, 1fr)); gap: 8px; }

.cc-deco-opt { background: var(--bg-3); border: 2px solid transparent; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 4px 6px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 6px; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 60%, transparent); font-size: 0.65rem; font-family: inherit; text-transform: capitalize; }
.cc-deco-label { max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }
.cc-deco-empty { grid-column: 1 / -1; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 50%, transparent); font-size: 0.8rem; padding: 8px 2px; }
.cc-deco-toolbar { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.cc-deco-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; background: var(--bg-2); padding: 3px; border-radius: 8px; }

.cc-deco-tabs button { background: none; border: none; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 60%, transparent); font: inherit; font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 5px 10px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: pointer; position: relative; }
.cc-deco-tabs button.has-active:not(.active)::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; right: 3px; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent); }

.cc-settings-form #ccDecoSearch { flex: 1; min-width: 140px; background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; color: var(--bright-text); padding: 7px 10px; font: inherit; font-size: 0.8rem; outline: none; }
.cc-settings-preview { width: 300px; flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; }
.cc-card { width: 300px; max-width: 100%; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; padding: 4px; box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5); }
.cc-card-inner { border-radius: 9px; overflow: hidden; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg-2) 60%, transparent); }
.cc-card-avatar { margin: -46px 0 0 14px; padding: 5px; border-radius: 50%; background: inherit; display: inline-block; }
.cc-card-body { padding: 6px 14px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; }

.cc-card-section { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bg) 25%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; padding: 10px; color: var(--text); font-size: 0.8rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }
.cc-card-section h6 { color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 70%, transparent); font-size: 0.62rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; }
.cc-badge { font-size: 0.62rem; font-weight: 600; color: var(--bright-text); background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 8%, transparent); padding: 2px 7px; border-radius: 6px; }
.cc-lightbox { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 80; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.85); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 20px; }
position: fixed; right: 22px; bottom: 96px; z-index: 30; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%;
background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-text); border: none; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
box-shadow: 0 6px 20px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 45%, transparent); transition: transform 0.15s, background 0.15s;

.cc-fab-badge { position: absolute; top: -2px; right: -2px; min-width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 10px; background: #ed4245; color: #fff; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 700; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 2px solid var(--bg-2); }
position: fixed; left: 50%; top: 64px; transform: translateX(-50%); z-index: 90;
background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--accent-2)); color: var(--accent-text); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.85rem;
padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4); animation: fadeIn 0.3s ease;
.cc-auth-tabs { display: flex; background: var(--bg-2); border-radius: 10px; padding: 4px; gap: 4px; margin-bottom: 4px; }

.cc-auth-tab { flex: 1; background: none; border: none; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 55%, transparent); font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px; border-radius: 7px; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; }
.cc-auth-tab:not(.active):hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 6%, transparent); color: var(--bright-text); }

.cc-settings-form .cc-pass-wrap input { width: 100%; background: var(--bg-2); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 6%, transparent); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--bright-text); padding: 11px 12px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 0.9rem; outline: none; }
.cc-pass-toggle { position: absolute; right: 6px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); background: none; border: none; font-size: 1rem; opacity: 0.55; padding: 4px 6px; }

.cc-thumb { background: var(--bg-2) center / cover no-repeat; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 8%, transparent); flex-shrink: 0; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--bright-text) 30%, transparent); font-size: 0.65rem; }
.cc-fx-neon { filter: drop-shadow(0 0 3px #ff2bd6) drop-shadow(0 0 6px #00f0ff); animation: cc-neon 1.8s ease-in-out infinite; }
.cc-fx-shimmer { background-image: linear-gradient(110deg, var(--cc-c1) 30%, #ffffff 50%, var(--cc-c2) 70%); background-size: 250% 100%; animation: cc-shimmer 2.6s linear infinite; }
.cc-fx-rainbow { background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, #ff004c, #ffb300, #3cff00, #00d0ff, #a100ff, #ff004c); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: cc-shimmer 3s linear infinite; }
.cc-fx-wave { display: inline-block; animation: cc-wave 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; }
@keyframes cc-wave { 0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0); } 25% { transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(-2deg); } 75% { transform: translateY(1px) rotate(2deg); } }
.cc-fx-sample { max-width: 100%; overflow: hidden; display: block; padding: 2px 4px; }
/* Profile effects (animated overlay on the whole profile card) */
.cc-pfx { position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 2; pointer-events: none; overflow: hidden; border-radius: inherit; }
.cc-pfx span { position: absolute; line-height: 1; opacity: 0; animation-iteration-count: infinite; animation-timing-function: linear; }
.cc-pfx-twinkle span:nth-child(odd) { top: 12%; } .cc-pfx-twinkle span:nth-child(3n) { top: 45%; } .cc-pfx-twinkle span:nth-child(4n) { top: 78%; } .cc-pfx-twinkle span:nth-child(5n) { top: 28%; }

.cc-pfx-orbs span { width: 12px; height: 12px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.7); background: radial-gradient(circle at 30% 30%, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6), rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05)); }

.cc-pfx-aurora span { inset: -20% -40%; background: linear-gradient(115deg, transparent 20%, rgba(60, 255, 180, 0.28), rgba(90, 120, 255, 0.3), rgba(220, 80, 255, 0.24), transparent 80%); filter: blur(14px); animation: cc-pfx-aurora 7s ease-in-out infinite alternate; }
.cc-pfx-glitch span { background: repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05) 0 1px, transparent 1px 3px); animation: cc-pfx-glitch 2.4s steps(1) infinite; }
@keyframes cc-pfx-aurora { from { transform: translateX(-12%) skewY(-4deg); } to { transform: translateX(12%) skewY(4deg); } }

@keyframes cc-pfx-glitch { 0%, 100% { transform: none; box-shadow: none; } 8% { transform: translateX(-3px); box-shadow: inset 3px 0 rgba(255, 0, 80, 0.35), inset -3px 0 rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.35); } 10% { transform: translateX(2px); } 12%, 60% { transform: none; box-shadow: none; } 62% { transform: translateY(2px); box-shadow: inset -2px 0 rgba(255, 0, 80, 0.3), inset 2px 0 rgba(0, 240, 255, 0.3); } }
/* Official Discord effects: full-width APNG layers anchored to the top of the card */
.cc-pfx-discord img { position: absolute; top: 0; left: 0; width: 100%; height: auto; opacity: 0; }

@keyframes cc-pfx-fall { 0% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0); opacity: 0; } 10% { opacity: 0.9; } 90% { opacity: 0.9; } 100% { transform: translateY(560px) translateX(24px) rotate(320deg); opacity: 0; } }

@keyframes cc-pfx-rise { 0% { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.7); opacity: 0; } 15% { opacity: 0.9; } 85% { opacity: 0.7; } 100% { transform: translateY(-560px) translateX(-16px) scale(1.1); opacity: 0; } }
@keyframes cc-pfx-twinkle { 0%, 100% { transform: scale(0.4); opacity: 0; } 50% { transform: scale(1.1); opacity: 1; } }
/* Roles: Verified is green (given by staff), the owner is gold, mods are red-gold */
display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 15px; height: 15px; border-radius: 50%;
background: #23a55a; color: #fff; font-size: 0.55rem; font-weight: 700; align-self: center; flex-shrink: 0;
font-size: 0.6rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 1px 7px; border-radius: 6px;
align-self: center; white-space: nowrap; background-size: 200% 100%; animation: cc-role-shine 4s linear infinite;
